retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast nocturnal portrait featuring a subject in dark ribbed knitwear against a textured asphalt ground with warm, focused facial lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-full shot of a woman with honey-blonde hair crouched on a dark asphalt surface at night. She wears a dark, ribbed turtleneck dress and black gloves, with her face illuminated by a warm, soft key light that creates a sharp contrast against the deep indigo and black shadows of the environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm facial highlights versus deep cool-toned shadows
Vertical ribbing of the garment contrasting with the granular texture of asphalt
Triangular composition formed by the crouched pose and bent arm
Subject's warm skin tones anchoring the center of a dark frame
coreInvariants: Warm, directional lighting on the face
Deep black or dark purple negative space in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame in a crouched position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, highlighted by the brightest light in the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the illuminated face, follows the line of the arm down to the legs, and rests on the texture of the asphalt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space at the top and sides emphasizes the isolation and intimacy of the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's face and the background; low saturation in the environment with rich, warm saturation on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and deep nocturnal blues

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast nocturnal portrait of a woman with honey-blonde hair in a bob, wearing a dark ribbed turtleneck, crouched on dark asphalt. Use warm key lighting on the face and deep shadows elsewhere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif in white or silver, positioned in the dark negative space at the top or bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting on the face warm and directional?
Is the clothing texture clearly ribbed?

adjustableVariables: Hair color (honey blonde to dark brown)
Lighting intensity (soft glow to hard shadow)
mustRedesign: Ensure the pose is crouched and grounded
Maintain the 90s film aesthetic with slight grain

mustAchieve: Clear texture on the ribbed knitwear
High contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Lighting is focused on the face
Ribbed texture of the dress is prominent
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal urban portrait + ribbed knitwear + warm key light + asphalt ground + 90s film grain.
